_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 5% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves, this is a coil where HOLD with conviction is the skilled call — a directional bet requires seeing the DXY break below 100 with gold holding 80+ and ETF flows staying elevated, none of which has confirmed yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — analyst explicitly defaults to HOLD citing coil stats and unconfirmed breakers; narrative implies forward bullishness but does not specify a directional call, so the consensus leans to the analyst's disciplined wait-and-see stance.
next_move.confirmed_if: DXY breaks below 100, gold holds 80+, ETF flows stay above 80, and BTC funding rises above 0.015% — this confirms Disbelief→Hope and upgrades signal to LONG
next_move.invalidated_if: DXY reclaims 101.5, VIX spikes above 20, ETF flows drop below 70, or BTC funding goes negative — any two of these kills the risk-on rotation thesis and shifts phase toward Anxiety
